B_subset: indices 0 through 31 of the unchanged frozen sample
A_gate: policy and WDL accuracy 100%, both CE < 0.05
B_C_gate: policy accuracy >=99%, WDL accuracy >=95%, both CE <=0.05
best_B_rule: Among passing B runs, minimize final policy CE + weighted WDL CE; tie breaks to lower LR. This diagnoses the tiny batch, not optimal pilot LR.
D_gate: original Stage 3A gate unchanged: policy accuracy >=99%, policy CE <=0.05, WDL accuracy >=95%, losses below initialization, finite, <=3000 steps
